label: sends
review: Send-sent-sent is irregular with shared past/participle PCM; carry changes y to i before es/ed but retains y in carrying. Godan ru okuru uses small tsu in past/te; godan bu hakobu uses nda/nde. Potential okureru is can send, not the distinct verb be late.
